scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @vns/shared && npm run build --workspace @vns/api && npm run build --workspace @vns/worker && npm run build --workspace @vns/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @vns/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.format:check: prettier --write apps/worker/src/feed-scheduler-composition.ts apps/worker/src/feed-scheduler-composition.test.ts && git diff --no-color -- apps/worker/src/feed-scheduler-composition.ts apps/worker/src/feed-scheduler-composition.test.ts && git diff --exit-code -- apps/worker/src/feed-scheduler-composition.ts apps/worker/src/feed-scheduler-composition.test.ts && prettier --check .
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace @vns/shared && npm run test --workspace @vns/shared && npm run test --workspace @vns/api && npm run test --workspace @vns/worker && npm run test --workspace @vns/web
